subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt native outbound Telegram album sending now, using https://github.com/julia-meshcheryakova/openclaw/pull/1 as the starting point, or keep current sequential multi-media fan-out until maintainers define a narrower channel contract?
rationale: This is a new visible Telegram channel capability with an open implementation candidate and multiple closed prior attempts, so automation should not supersede contributor work or choose permanent album semantics without owner direction.

options.title: Review or port the linked PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Define a narrower album contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify exactly which outbound surfaces and media kinds should use native Telegram albums.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Treat current sequential `mediaUrls` fan-out as the supported behavior for now and explicitly defer Telegram album grouping.

recommendation.title: Review or port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest issue-level routing signal from the prior cleanup review and subsequent timeline mentions on this topic.
